title: Finish Procedural 3d End to End
description: Fix procedural3d wasm plugin build and verify dev:procedural:3d boots end-to-end with flow graph and 3d preview.
summary: Fixed wasm plugin builds by correcting getrandom_backend cfg quoting in .cargo/config.toml (nightly rustc rejects unquoted value syntax). Removed duplicate GraphContextMenuItem type in node-graph-host.tsx that blocked React lazy-load of the flow graph. Rebuilt procedural3d_plugin.wasm, refreshed plugin-modules, and verified dev:procedural:3d boots with flow graph + world-3d preview via e2e-verify.ts (preview ratio 1.0, no console errors).
